cause.confirmed: The shared opening service applied Black Crown one-time reward guards to Blue Gear. Both named accounts have CONSUMED Black Crown records, while Blue Gear intentionally has no onceSnapshot. The guard required those unrelated records to be absent and failed with PostgreSQL23514 before payment or any acquisition.
cause.earlierFixLimit: The previous patch repaired the busy recovery-button loop, but did not diagnose this account-specific server guard failure. The current screenshot was reproduced with the same consumed entitlement condition.
cause.change: Run blackcrownOnceStatements only when pack.id is BLACKCROWN_PACK.id. Preserve ARMED/CONSUMED Black Crown history and original Black Crown entitlement behavior. Other pack limits, prices, odds, stock, and existing Blue Gear 1000T limit are unchanged.

receipt.policy: Resume only the latest original user-authorized 100T request per named account, keep its saved lottery, cancel older unpaid attempts without changing their plans, preserve Black Crown reward records.
